scope: A04 combat/main insertion and attack callbacks; linked exile attacking copies; exact source defender exemption; temporary-token delayed sacrifice; delayed creature-entry drain; delayed noncreature-cast template. Shared engine only.

cards.name: All-Out Assault
cards.oracle_text:
Creatures you control get +1/+1 and have deathtouch.
When this enchantment enters, if it's your main phase, there is an additional combat phase after this phase followed by an additional main phase. When you next attack this turn, untap each creature you control.

cards.name: Dalkovan Encampment
cards.oracle_text:
This land enters tapped unless you control a Swamp or a Mountain.
{T}: Add {W}.
{2}{W}, {T}: Whenever you attack this turn, create two 1/1 red Warrior creature tokens that are tapped and attacking. Sacrifice them at the beginning of the next end step.

cards.name: Mardu Siegebreaker
cards.oracle_text:
Deathtouch, haste
When this creature enters, exile up to one other target creature you control until this creature leaves the battlefield.
Whenever this creature attacks, for each opponent, create a tapped token that's a copy of the exiled card attacking that opponent. At the beginning of your next end step, sacrifice those tokens.

cards.name: Krotiq Nestguard
cards.oracle_text:
Defender
{2}{G}: This creature can attack this turn as though it didn't have defender.

cards.name: Salt Road Skirmish
cards.oracle_text: Destroy target creature. Create two 1/1 red Warrior creature tokens. They gain haste until end of turn. Sacrifice them at the beginning of the next end step.

cards.name: Thunder of Unity
cards.oracle_text:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)
I — You draw two cards and you lose 2 life.
II, III — Whenever a creature you control enters this turn, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.

cards.name: Rediscover the Way
cards.oracle_text:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)
I, II — Look at the top three cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in any order.
III — Whenever you cast a noncreature spell this turn, target creature you control gains double strike until end of turn.

audit_reconciliation: Empty-card groups resolve to Krotiq Nestguard, Mardu Siegebreaker and Rediscover the Way.

Existing ScheduleAttackTriggerThisTurn already supports source-independent repeated nonempty declarations. It is preserved and used for Dalkovan; new generic rows supply one-shot policy and cast/entry events.
New spell-copy callback is specialized copying, so it does not replace Rediscover’s arbitrary targeted noncreature-cast template.
source_discrepancies: Mardu Java chooses one linked card when copied ETB triggers exile multiple. CR607.3 explicitly requires one token copy for EACH linked exiled card. Rust batches each recipe and exposes no choice.
The release-note body uses earlier Mardu end-step wording; current Oracle and the Java timing helper specify controller next end step. Rust uses controller-next-end timing.
implementation: Cold explicit phase-successor stack inserts combat/main pairs last-created first, preserving legacy consecutive combat behavior when used alone and promoting its frozen successor only when mixed.

Generic owned callback rows live inside existing CombatRulesState: Attack, NoncreatureCast and CreatureEntry with explicit once/repeat. Empty declarations and put-attacking events do not trigger attack rows; original controller/template and exact departure source facts survive source departure, reentry or text changes until cleanup.

Noncreature casts use the actual selected spell face and only committed casts; targets are selected when the callback trigger is stacked. Creature-entry rows dispatch per actual entrant/controller and respect entry-trigger suppression even when no permanent observer remains.

Exact source defender permission uses the shared declaration/mandatory-attack eligibility predicate, retaining defender and surviving resolved recipient copy/control changes until cleanup; a new incarnation never inherits it.

Temporary token instructions are owned through creation replacements and entry choices. Keywords apply after actual entry; one-shot sacrifice captures every actual replacement-created exact recipient, including added groups. No predicted-generation recipients are granted early.

Mardu copies physical printed exile card recipes from exact still-linked cards, separated by acquired-template origin. Tokens enter tapped, attack the opponent only if creatures after entry, and have controller-next-end exact sacrifice. Multiple links copy each under CR607.3; original source departure returns all still-linked physical cards regardless of current text.

Frozen ability origins are propagated by target, mass, revealed-hand and attached-copy linked-return creation paths. Native links remain dormant through temporary copies; fresh copied templates cannot use original or prior copied links.

The proven battle-only Mobilize omission is repaired by building the existing plan and consulting visit_mobilize_actions for a legal nondefault defender. It reuses actual public defender enumeration rather than a second PW/battle predicate.
focused_proofs: Both seats: additional combat then main, natural main1 normal-combat/main2-end successors, latest insertion first with old combats, effect created within inserted main, frozen phase branches after parent disposal.
Assault own-main intervening-if, source departure, empty declaration ignored, one-shot consumed by countering, distinct surviving instance, untap current creatures including a later entrant.
Dalkovan repeated registrations each trigger on every nonempty declaration after source leaves; put-attacking tokens do not recurse; ordinary next-end sacrifice.
Real paid defender activation rejects unfunded announcement, retains defender, survives text/control change, and expires at cleanup or real zone change.

Delayed cast targets own creatures at trigger stacking, actor privacy/illegal target/wrong-actor/stale revision rollback, raw/index/sibling/restore; actual selected Adventure face and countered original still trigger, uncast copies do not.
Two separate entry observers trigger per simultaneous creature entrant, ignore opponent creatures/noncreature tokens, and obey source-independent suppression with no permanent observer.
Delayed source targeting reads live or departure color and does not rebind after source reentry.

Salt ordinary tokens untapped/hasty, illegal target causes no effects, indestructible legal target still creates; real added/doubled groups and explicit entry-copy/timestamp continuations retain exact results.
Countered delayed sacrifice consumes the one-shot packet; stolen recipient and reused old token slots never rebind.

Mardu printed blueprint excludes former counters/buffs; real ETB trigger, source departure, exiled token ceasing, noncreature physical blueprint, tapped attacking entry without attack trigger, own next-end timing, copied ETB multiple links, copied-template separation and pending old-template reads.
Live Elspeth loyalty5 remains present for printed-storm copy proof; the same source positively doubles an ordinary creation event.
Independent owned raw/index/restore roots cover new phase continuation, callback target selection and suspended token entry completion.

artifact_availability_correction.reason: Remove the false required/preserved classification of a mutable Cargo cdylib for this native Rust test checkpoint. All historical path/hash/report/command records remain unchanged. Exact compiler proc-macro libraries are retained as compile-time dependencies.
artifact_availability_correction.execution_mode: The recorded reports compile Rust integration tests with cargo test -p rustmage --test TARGET --no-run --message-format=json, then directly execute the reported native ELF under the bounded native runner. That runner contains no ctypes/cffi/CDLL load. Rust integration tests consume the rlib; Cargo also emits a cdylib because the crate requests both formats. No recorded command in this checkpoint requires that cdylib.
artifact_availability_correction.availability_scope: Current warm-output availability is stated only for this inspection. Replaced or changing historical bytes are not claimed preserved, and no new hashes replace the original observations. No cache restoration, deletion, rebuild or runtime edit was performed.
